_comment: Mascot layer config, read by pipeline/orchestrate.mjs. `src` is relative to video/public/ and MUST point at an alpha WebM produced by tools/chromakey.mjs — the raw clips in assets/video/ are yuv420p and would composite as an opaque rectangle.
_status: mas3 is the best available key and it is NOT clean: holes in the light fur at the ears and muzzle, from a light-grey background too close to cream fur. See docs/mascot-keying.md. Keep `width` small — the artefacts are on the fur edges and mostly disappear under ~520px. Replace with a real alpha export when one exists.
